After one week in Phnom Penh city, I am evacuating in order to retreat back into nature.

Anyone who did not get the opportunity to get together with me, should keep in touch as I travel around Cambodia for a while longer.
My new phone number, but you cannot call me. I use this card for data only. Cambodia has the lowest prices in the world for cellular service.

I am taking a short bicycle journey to our land base, as shown here.

Phnom Penh.
Very successful.

Outdoor air quality is super-sub standard, worst anywhere I have ever been with middle class people, such as these.

Of course, China and India have such areas, and personally I will avoid them all, never wanting to step or ride in into or even around any of them.

Such habitat is deceptive, and similar to Pol Pot ordering the evacuation of Phnom Penh, some one should do it again, but for different reasons.

Found an abandoned growers shack in an old poorly maintained mango Grove which was situated on power line easement.

Think about the possibilities with such a great piece of property.

It is about a kilometer to the north off the highway.

Now I am at a school, from the turn off to the secret mango grove, all nearby walking distance for kids.

Now kids are arriving for school day wondering why I am sitting here.

Along the highway there are internal combustion engines powering platforms of human labor with using only basic simple common sense for laws of safety and human longevity while no one is hurt. 

I tell out to them in a loud bark and they respond with greetings.

Many of them are dead with cold blank stares.
Now just sitting here I must get out because many want to approach me.
